She is comfortable keeping her own opinion; her curiosity may be sharp and a little odd. She is not displaying Sakiko's formal composure, a universal reassuring smile, or a generic book-reading advertisement. This small internal discovery matters more than a showy gesture.

An ordinary open small book rests on her thighs/lap; her hands hold its edges simply, with coherent sleeves, wrists and a few naturally legible fingers. Her torso is relaxed and upright, hips visibly sink into the cushion, bent knees and lower legs connect naturally, black boots relate honestly to the floor. A slight independent head turn and lifted gaze from the book bring this moment alive. Keep complete head, hair and boots inside the frame. Do not reach across empty space to the distant writing desk. Identity remains unmistakable: short silver-white soft bob with pale lavender tips and relaxed bangs; Rana's own right iris gold, own left iris blue (front-facing viewer-left gold/viewer-right blue). Separate eyelids, irises, brows and fine strands; readable eyes not hidden by bangs. Original loose black short sleeve outer shirt over pale white long sleeves, white shorts and black lace-up ankle boots. Youthful anime rendering integrated into richly textured luminous fabric, wood and sunlight; face has awake private interest, perhaps a small parted mouth, not a forced grin. Keep shared environment light and grounded contact shadows, finely separated eyelashes and hair. Book typography is only faint unreadable texture. No UI, captions, readable message, cat, guitar, extra people, costume change or artificial glow. Preserve the room as one cohesive complete scene.
